description: Two wave folders on one panel, each reflecting a signal back on itself above a threshold and then applying a gain

params.text: Sets the voltage at which that half folds, 0V at fully counter-clockwise to 6V fully clockwise
Sets the gain applied after folding, silent at fully counter-clockwise and five times fully clockwise

inputs.text: Adds to that half's fold threshold, one volt per volt
Adds to that half's gain, half a unit per volt

outputs.text: The folded signal at the gain set for that half

notes: with the threshold knob fully counter-clockwise and nothing patched to its threshold input the threshold is 0V, and every part of the signal is reflected, which inverts it
